display.purpose: Set only inside a FlapCell: headline, score, short status/tag words. Never a full sentence.

body.purpose: Every full sentence — subheads, finding descriptions, section copy.

label.purpose: Small uppercase mono captions and numbered markers.

motion.name: flap-turn
motion.purpose: Per-character flip when a FlapCell's displayed character changes during its reveal cycle.

motion.name: row-in
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance for findings rows and numbered steps once their section scrolls into view.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted-fill CTA — used for every Sign up action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fafafa; color: #0a0a0a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font-weight: 500; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #52525b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: Secondary text-only action — used for Log in beside a primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #52525b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flap Cell
components.description: Signature component: a fixed-width mechanical character cell with a simulated split-flap seam. Cycles through random characters before landing on its target on first scroll-into-view.
components.css: .ds-flap-cell { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.6em; width: 1.05em; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #27272a; background: #141414; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; } .ds-flap-fold { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 50% 0; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(10,10,10,0.25)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-flap-seam { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: rgba(10,10,10,0.7); pointer-events: none; } .ds-flap-char { position: relative; z-index: 10; }

components.name: Flap Cell — Critical
components.description: Flap cell variant for a critical/failing finding's leading tag.

components.name: Sample Panel
components.description: Bordered content panel — used for the illustrative sample-analysis board.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(20,20,20,0.6); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #a1a1aa; }

components.name: Ruled Row
components.description: A findings/steps list row separated by a hairline border rather than an individual card.
components.css: .ds-ruled-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; } .ds-ruled-row p { color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Header Nav
components.description: Flat top navigation: wordmark left, auth-aware action right (Log in/Sign up when signed out, single Dashboard button when signed in).
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; } .ds-header-brand { font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #fafafa; }

narrative.overview: AstroJobs reads its own product output the way a concourse board reads a flight: a result arrives by resolving into place, one fixed-width character at a time, not by fading in. The system was chosen by running an assigned direction (drawn by lot from a grounded candidate list) against six catalog challengers on two axes — audience identification and product clarity — and the split-flap board won both outright: its mechanical, satisfying reveal is the closest visual analogue this product has to "your score is ready," and its native palette (matte near-black boards, white cells, one reserved warning color) was already the app's own dark theme before this surface existed. The palette is deliberately narrow: the app's pre-existing near-black/near-white pair, plus the single existing destructive red repurposed as the board's one warning lamp. No new hues were introduced for this surface — restraint here is a constraint inherited from the product's existing screens, not a stylistic choice invented for the landing page alone.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed-cell mechanical typography (Martian Mono) for anything that "resolves" — headlines, scores, status tags — set apart from ordinary prose.
A strictly two-tone palette: near-black and near-white, with red reserved exclusively for a failing/critical signal, never decoration.
Flat, bordered surfaces — no gradients, no glass, no soft glow shadows.
Content structured as ruled rows (findings lists, numbered steps) rather than bordered card grids.

rules.name: The One Warning Lamp Rule
rules.body: destructive (#ef4444) is the only color outside the black/white pair anywhere in the system. It marks exactly one thing: a failing or critical finding. It never decorates a heading, a hover state, or an icon that isn't reporting a failure.

rules.name: The Mechanical/Human Split Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono speaks only through discrete, boxed character cells. Hanken Grotesk carries every full sentence. A headline never sets in Hanken Grotesk, and a paragraph never sets in Martian Mono — swapping their jobs breaks the board metaphor.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing outside a FlapCell's internal seam ever carries a shadow, glow, or gradient. Depth comes from a bordered panel one tone lighter than its ground, full stop.

dos: Do reserve destructive red exclusively for a critical/failing finding — never for emphasis, decoration, or a second accent.
Do set any text that "resolves" (headline, score, short status tags) in Martian Mono inside a FlapCell; set every full sentence in Hanken Grotesk.
Do trigger a FlapCell reveal once per element, on first scroll-into-view, and skip the character-cycle entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do separate list rows (findings, steps) with a single hairline border rather than individual card boxes.
donts: Don't introduce a color outside the existing background/foreground/card/muted/border/primary/destructive set.
Don't add a drop shadow, glow, or gradient anywhere outside a FlapCell's internal fold seam.
Don't set a full sentence in Martian Mono, or a headline/score in Hanken Grotesk.
Don't replay a FlapCell's character-cycle on every scroll past it — it fires once, the first time it enters view.
